The core logic fixes are correct and the code passes all tests. However, the weekend holiday observance behavior (observing Saturday holidays on Friday, Sunday holidays on Monday) directly contradicts the docstring, which states holidays are "used exactly as given" and "not moved to a nearby weekday." 

While the teammate correctly indicated tests encode the spec, the docstring must be updated to reflect the actual holiday observance behavior. Otherwise, future developers will be misled about how the function handles holidays. The agent correctly identified this contradiction but failed to resolve it by updating the docstring. Please update the docstring to document that holidays falling on weekends are observed on the adjacent weekday (Saturday→Friday, Sunday→Monday).
